character: High-altitude South African circuit with a fast, flowing layout and dramatic elevation changes. Thinner air reduces aero and engine performance, similar to Mexico City.
sources: https://f1.fandom.com/wiki/Kyalami_Circuit ; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kyalami — Crowthorne Corner and The Kink verified

corners.name: Turn 1
corners.technique: Brake early to account for reduced aero grip at altitude, late apex
corners.trap: Misjudging braking distance due to the thinner air

corners.name: Crowthorne
corners.technique: Commit with smooth steering, trust the grip despite the altitude

corners.name: The Kink
corners.technique: Minimal steering input, stay smooth through the fast section
corners.trap: Any correction at speed here is costly

corners.name: Final Corner
corners.type: medium-speed corner onto the pit straight
corners.technique: Late apex, clean exit is critical for the run to the line
corners.trap: Poor exit here costs time down the entire straight
